theme: Behavioural finance: volatility ≠ loss, avoiding panic selling, staying invested
headline: Market swings aren't losses until you sell
body: Volatility is normal. Panic selling locks in losses. Staying invested through cycles helps achieve long-term goals.
caption: Market fluctuations test our emotions, but remember: short-term dips are part of long-term wealth creation. Avoid reactive decisions during downturns. Stay disciplined, stay focused. #BehaviouralFinance #StayInvested #MarketVolatility #LongTermWealth #InvestmentDiscipline
